content.body: jarhar: what's the rationale in https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/12263 for making `moveBefore()` more async than `appendChild`?
content.formatted_body: jarhar: what's the rationale in https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/12263 for making moveBefore() more async than appendChild?

content.body:
I was reviewing [the Firefox patch implementing this](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D314004) and it feels super weird to have code like:

```
if (isMove) { UpdateInMicroTask(); } else { UpdateInPostConnectionSteps(); }
```
